audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phase 'why' is boilerplate that names Feast as the lane cooldown. Feast is an 80s ultimate, not the thing that decides levels 1-5.
audit.why: Feral Scream (W) is on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 and Rupture (Q) on a flat 6s. Those, not Feast, decide whether Akali can step up.
audit.corrected: All seven phase reasons rewritten around Rupture's telegraph, Feral Scream's silence and Akali's own W (20s) / E (16s) timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text pointed at 'Feast's cooldown' for the first-item window and said nothing about why the 2-item stage stops being free.
audit.why: Akali's real spikes are W at 2, full kit at 3, first item, and 2 items; Cho'Gath's are Feral Scream rank-ups and every Feast stack.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and phases[6].why now key the first-item all-in to his stack count, and the 2-item line states that six stacks out-tank one rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to build MR for Feast. Feast deals true damage — magic resist does nothing against it. The silence lockout was also never stated.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/akali.json flags 'Cho'Gath bypasses stacking resistances (Feast (R))'. Feast is flagged trueDamage + percentHealth in the kit file. Feral Scream is a silence, which locks Akali's W, E and R — the whole reason her escape pattern fails here.
audit.corrected: tldr, dosFull[1] and report[5] now say to skip MR and stay above the threshold; the silence lockout is stated in dontsFull[1] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Rupture 6s flat, Feral Scream 11s at rank 1, Feast 80s at rank 1, Akali W 20s and E 16s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their own titles — 'Get silenced mid-combo' was described as 'burning it for tiny value'.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to explain its own title.

edits.before: Build MR — dodge his Q, Q-poke his immobile body. Akali wins the Feast cooldown windows.
edits.after: Skip MR — dodge his Q, punish the silence. Akali wins the Feral Scream cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his CC and poke him down. Track Feast before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his Rupture and bait out Feral Scream. Kill him before Feast stacks out-tank your rotation.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Cho'Gath contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Rupture reaches 950 to your 550 kunai and its knockup sets up Feral Scream. Last-hit at Q tip — you have no Shroud yet.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Cho'Gath's Feast is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it only while Feral Scream (11s) is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Cho'Gath must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: Shroud (20s) breaks his Rupture setup, and an Assassin's Mark auto punishes every step he takes to farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Feast's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: trade on Feral Scream's cooldown, not Feast's. E-mark him (16s), then step out for the empowered auto.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cho'Gath's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes, but Feast (80s) is a true-damage threshold kill — never sit low while it is up.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Feast's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment it lands, while his stacks are few.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Cho'Gath carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and your pattern peaks, but every Feast stack widens the health bar you must burn — close it out early.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Feast: matchup-defining — True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Feral Scream (11s at rank 1): the real lane cooldown — silenced you lose W, E and R. - Rupture: only 6s, never count it out. - Feast (80s): true damage, so stay above the threshold, not behind MR.

edits.before: Q Cho'Gath at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at your 550 max range, E-mark and dash once Feral Scream is spent, then Shroud his Rupture answer.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Stepping into Rupture range with Shroud down — knockup into silence is his entire kill pattern.

edits.before: Q Cho'Gath at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Feast is true damage — magic resist reads zero against it. Stay above the threshold instead.

edits.before: Cho'Gath wastes Feast — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Shroud as the Rupture circle blooms; his scream whiffs too.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Rupture's circle blooms before it lands — walk out of it and his engage is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream locks your W, E and R — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Feast is a flat true-damage threshold — below it, no shroud and no magic resist saves you.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath's Feast: True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences W, E and R; Feast is true damage, so MR is wasted. Fight on the silence.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Drop Twilight Shroud' in wants.you[1] — false positive, the name is correct per the kit file. Two things I could not fix: (1) full-layer focus.text is 'Cho'Gath Feast' (letters R) but the lane is decided by Feral Scream (W) — focus is not on the writable path list. (2) content whys[6] says Cho'Gath's 2-item health pool out-tanks your combo while content win[6] and full phases[6].side both say 'Akali'; the champion-name enum is too short to swap inside the +/-10% length band, so it needs a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass.
